R221.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync parameterizes accountId/status/beforeUtc correctly; return type and row-count contract preserved.

R222.note: scanf("%15s",...) closes the overflow but silently truncates an oversized token and returns 0 instead of rejecting it with -1 as the contract requires; not disclosed.

R223.note: res.sendFile(requestedFile, { root }) is Express's own containment mechanism for this exact sink; removal of the now-unused reportPath is stated.

R224.note: HTML-entity escaping applied to the reported source before interpolation into the template literal; no other output changed.

R225.note: ValidAlgorithms pinning to RS256 is a real TokenValidationParameters property (confirmed compiling against Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens); orthogonal jku/SSRF concern explicitly disclosed as out of scope.

R226.note: offset + length > capacity can integer-overflow (wrap) for attacker-controlled offset near SIZE_MAX, bypassing the check; correct form is offset > capacity || length > capacity - offset. No other behavior change for normal inputs.

R227.note: ValidateRuleCodeStructure calls tree.GetCompilationUnitSyntax(), which does not exist on SyntaxTree (confirmed by compiling against Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp 5.9.0 - CS1061; the real API is GetCompilationUnitRoot()), so the fix does not compile; separately the invocation-only blacklist misses extern+[DllImport] P/Invoke declarations (AttributeSyntax, not InvocationExpressionSyntax).

R228.note: Adds the '--' end-of-options marker before filenames, matching tar semantics; filenames not starting with '-' are unaffected.

R229.note: crypto/rand.Read is the correct CSPRNG API, but hex-encoding 32 random bytes silently produces a 64-character hex key instead of the contractually-required 32-character key from keyAlphabet; not disclosed as a format change.

R230.note: pathlib resolve(strict=True) + is_relative_to(BASE_DIR) correctly rejects absolute-path and traversal attempts while still serving files under BASE_DIR; 404/400 behavior preserved.

R231.note: shared_ptr captured by value in the lambda extends the Session's lifetime exactly as the contract's 'own/share' branch requires; signature change is shown plainly in the diff.

R232.note: Argument-array exec.Command to convert removes the shell entirely, satisfying the stated contract that shell metacharacters be treated as literal data; argument order/semantics unchanged.

R233.note: Extension now derived from the server-detected content type via an allowlisted map instead of the client filename; map covers exactly the previously allowed content types.

R234.note: Removing mark_safe() closes the XSS but also lets Django's autoescape escape the intended <div class='announcement'> wrapper markup itself, so the banner would render as literal escaped tags rather than styled HTML; only weakly gestured at via an alternate-approach mention, not stated as a consequence of the chosen fix.

R235.note: resolve_entities=False plus load_dtd=False is the standard lxml XXE hardening; well-formed XML without external entities still parses.

R236.note: PreparedStatement with a bound ? parameter is the correct replacement for Statement string concatenation; output formatting and control flow otherwise unchanged.

R237.note: SHA-256 allowlist is a reasonable control given no .NET Core sandboxing exists, but it silently requires every plugin to be pre-approved before upload, defeating the endpoint's stated purpose of ad hoc runtime plugin extension; this trade-off is stated openly in the write-up's key-changes list.

R238.note: Key(publicKey, 'RS256') binds a single explicit algorithm, closing the HS256/RS256 confusion; the previously-passed hmacSecret was already unused/dead in the vulnerable code, so no legitimate HS256 path is removed.
